title: WAGO: Unauthorized Account Access via Credential Recovery Process
description: CVE-2026-18963 is a vulnerability in WAGO version 7.36.156 involving the credential recovery process that allows unauthorized account takeover. Exploiting this flaw could enable attackers to access application resources with the privileges of the compromised user, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive data, misuse of privileged functions, and modification of system settings.
